'''Paul Hodges''' won the [[1997 Dantooine Regionals (Tulsa)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I am 17 and a Senior at Owasso High School, where I'm on the Academic Bowl team and am a member of the Chess and Spanish Clubs."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/hodges.html Paul Hodges], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427201927/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/hodges.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"In my free time I like to play basketball."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I plan to go to college next year, but I don't know where as yet."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"A couple of strange facts: 1) At the Regional, I played my uncle, Bill Gordon, in the final round,."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"and 2) I am probably the only qualifier not to own any Dark Side cards."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"This is because my friend, Will Sleightholm and I split all of our cards."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I hope I do better at this year's World Championship that at last year's, when I was one place away from making the final twelve."<ref name="dec97bio" />
